title: I Will Extol Thee, Lord, on High
description: I Will Extol Thee, Lord, on High in Tonic Solfa to WINCHESTER NEW, doh is C: the solfa with the words, staff notation, 3 verses and a piano.
about: Isaac Watts wrote these words for The Psalms of David Imitated in the Language of the New Testament (1719): Psalm 30, part 1, headed “Sickness healed, and sorrow removed”.
Watts' psalms were printed without tunes and sung to any tune of their metre, Long Metre (8.8.8.8). This page sets the words to WINCHESTER NEW; any other Long Metre tune fits them as well.
underlay: I will ex-tol thee, Lord, on high, At thy com-mand, dis-eas-es fly; Who but a God can speak and save From the dark bor-ders of the grave?

lines: I will extol thee, Lord, on high,
Who but a God can speak and save
From the dark borders of the grave?
Sing to the Lord, ye saints of his,
And tell how large his goodness is;
Let all your powers rejoice and bless,
His anger but a moment stays
His love is life and length of days;
Tho' grief and tears the night employ,

source: Isaac Watts, The Psalms of David Imitated (1719)
licence: Public domain: Isaac Watts died in 1748.
credits: Words by Isaac Watts (1674–1748), public domain; set to WINCHESTER NEW by NoteFusion, as words-only hymn books were sung.
